notes.title: Capcom’s Spring Sale is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3]■Unbeatable Deals – Save up to 87% on Fan-Favorite Titles!
For the first time ever, Monster Hunter Stories, the first RPG in the iconic Monster Hunter series, is 34% off!
Also, Monster Hunter Stories 2 and Monster Hunter Stories Collection will be on sale at the same time!
Raise your own monster, build an unbreakable bond, and set off on an epic, world-spanning adventure.

Plus, fan-favorite franchises like Resident Evil, Street Fighter, and Mega Man are available at amazing prices.
Don’t miss your chance to score Capcom’s most popular games at incredible discounts![/h3]

notes.title: Capcom Holiday Deals Now Live
notes.content:
[h3]■Capcom Discount Sale: Up to 87% Off Popular Titles!
Don't miss this chance to own the Capcom's popular titles at incredible prices. Enjoy these great deals while they last!
"Ace Attorney Investigations Collection" will be released at up to 25% off for the first time ever!
Plus, from the popular "Monster Hunter" series, "Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak" and "Monster Hunter Rise + Sunbreak Set" are now available at the largest discount ever of 75%!
Play Capcom popular titles with your friends and family at the end of 2024![/h3]
